name: Hallow's End decorations stand on the patch-WB1 Crossroads inn
contract: Hallow's End decorations at the Crossroads inn (map 1) must stand on the inn they decorate. patch-WB1 moves the inn WMO: its MODF placement in World\Maps\Kalimdor\Kalimdor_36_32.adt is at (-403.24,-2644.13,94.94) with yaw 13.0 degrees in common-2.MPQ and at (-394.52,-2642.66,94.93) with yaw 9.76 degrees in patch-WB1.MPQ. Decorations that belong to the inn follow that rigid transform. Pumpkins whose patch-WB1 supports are gone (clan banners 364149 and 390055, tauren windbreaks 228091 and 364130, crates 343779 and 343780 in the common-2 MDDF, absent from patch-WB1) rest on the ground beneath them, and pumpkin 37328 follows orc crate doodad 350790, which patch-WB1 moves from (-489.26,-2679.09,97.26) to (-486.45,-2675.51,97.39). The floating ghosts 180411 and the bats are airborne by design and the skull lights 180471 hang under the eaves, so they are not asserted. Before the fix the roof pumpkins read 8.6 to 73.8 yd above the ground below them.
